source: Deployment and incident log · CD-309, INC-228

changeFailRate.label: Change fail rate, Payments
changeFailRate.note: Share of Payments deployments that needed a rollback or hotfix. DORA treats this as a measure of delivery instability. It peaked at {{X01:changeFailRate:at(8)}} in week 9 with release R-214. DORA advises against setting it as a target, because targets invite gaming.

recoveryTime.label: Failed deployment recovery, Payments
recoveryTime.note: How long it took to recover from a Payments deployment that failed. It peaked at {{X01:recoveryHours:at(8)}} in week 9. Read it next to the change fail rate, which pulls the other way from deployment speed.
